trends.insight: Hosts want diverse textures and shapes without spending hours baking separate batches.
trends.move: Film Sam styling an effortless holiday board using our mixed six-pack.
trends.name: No-Bake Holiday Cookie Boards
trends.risk: Visual boards look cluttered if cookies are stacked haphazardly.
trends.what: Real Simple published guides highlighting curated multi-cookie plates over single-batch baking.
trends.why_us: Our mixed 6-pack and 12-pack provide instant variety and bakery-fresh textures.

trends.insight: Editors and gift shoppers are prioritizing high-end food treats priced below twenty-five dollars.
trends.move: Anchor website banners and counter signs around thoughtful gifting under $25.
trends.name: Food Gift Guides Under $25
trends.risk: Overlooking shipping cutoffs could deter early online purchasers.
trends.what: Delish published an editor-curated gift roundup specifically featuring food items under $25.
trends.why_us: Our Box of 6 retails at $18, hitting the exact sweet spot.

trends.insight: Friendsgiving hosts face prep fatigue and rely on guests bringing easy handheld desserts.
trends.move: Position our 12-cookie box as the stress-free potluck dessert centerpiece.
trends.name: Friendsgiving Handheld Dessert Demand
trends.risk: Pie traditions remain strong unless cookie convenience is clearly demonstrated.
trends.what: Reports show 52% of younger adults attend Friendsgiving and actively outsource dessert courses.
trends.why_us: Our Holiday Box of 12 delivers generous sharing without slicing or plating.

trends.insight: Chains are shifting toward corporate visuals while dessert lovers crave real baker authenticity.
trends.move: Film Méline preparing fresh dough batches to celebrate genuine local baking.
trends.name: Counter Warmth Beats Corporate Rebrands
trends.risk: Sounding negative toward competitors instead of highlighting our handmade baking craft.
trends.what: Insomnia Cookies launched a widespread corporate brand refresh and multi-market expansion blueprint.
trends.why_us: Our Brooklyn kitchen and counter stories offer personal human warmth chains lack.

trends.insight: Shoppers seek artisanal food countdowns over cheap supermarket chocolate calendars.
trends.move: Promote the 12-box digitally as a December 12-day tasting experience.
trends.name: Artisan Food Advent Countdowns
trends.risk: Complex packaging lead times if custom advent boxes are required.
trends.what: Bon Appétit highlighted consumers choosing specialty food countdowns over traditional advent chocolate.
trends.why_us: Our Holiday Box of 12 translates into a premium 12-day countdown box.

trends.insight: Families plan gatherings early as cultural institutions roll out December holiday programming.
trends.move: Monitor demand and prepare festive neutral gifting ribbons for December.
trends.name: Early Hanukkah Celebration Spotlights
trends.risk: Lacking kosher certification restricts general faith-specific claims.
trends.what: Cultural centers announced Hanukkah festivals while Canada Post unveiled holiday stamps.
trends.why_us: Blue ribbon gifting on our 12-pack suits community celebration tables.

trends.insight: Home bakers share mid-century vintage desserts to spark warm holiday nostalgia.
trends.move: Keep watching if nostalgic flavor cues increase around Thanksgiving baking.
trends.name: Nostalgic Comfort Recipe Resurgence
trends.risk: Distracting from core holiday cookie sales with unrelated vintage recipes.
trends.what: Editorial sites report surges in classic 7UP cakes and retro ambrosia bakes.
trends.why_us: Our Snickerdoodle taps nostalgic spice memories without altering our core line.

trends.insight: Mass retail and fast-food chains offer promotional discounts and free items.
trends.move: Skip promotional discounts entirely while honoring community service genuinely.
trends.name: Veterans Day Discount Freebies
trends.risk: Breaking our no-discounting policy diminishes brand equity and margin.
trends.what: Chains nationwide rolled out extensive Veterans Day dining and merchandise discounts.
trends.why_us: Our house rules strictly ban discounting cookies or joining coupon races.

trends.insight: Chain bakeries lean on video game crossovers to spark artificial weekly buzz.
trends.move: Skip novelty stunts and double down on pure chocolate craftsmanship.
trends.name: Novelty Video Game Bakery Gimmicks
trends.risk: Chasing licensed IP dilutes our premium neighborhood bakery credibility.
trends.what: Crumbl introduced Minecraft grass block cakes and licensed video game sweets.
trends.why_us: We bake small-batch cookies with browned butter, not cartoon gimmicks.
